search_notes: Alphabetical, unranked candidate set checked on 2026-10-02 using UTC dates and a 90-day cutoff of 2026-07-04. Every included repository was verified through gh api repos/OWNER/REPO and repos/OWNER/REPO/releases/latest, plus its upstream README; each exists, is not archived, and has a qualifying release or default-branch commit. Published Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 assets were checked where available; CredSweeper documents Python installation, and Rusty Hog documents cargo builds. Three entries require inferred integration work to cover both jobs with one scanner: Secretlint would consume exported Git content through its documented stdin interface; Titus and Rusty Hog would need Git-hook gates that interpret their structured findings. Those integrations were not demonstrated or tested here. ggshield requires GitGuardian’s hosted API. The detect-secrets seed fails recency: its latest release is [v1.5.0, 2024-05-06](https://github.com/Yelp/detect-secrets/releases/tag/v1.5.0), and its [latest default-branch commit is 2026-04-02](https://github.com/Yelp/detect-secrets/commit/5e141933554a). Additional exclusions include [Nosey Parker, which is archived](https://github.com/praetorian-inc/noseyparker), and [Prowl, whose README specifies PolyForm Noncommercial licensing](https://github.com/Lercas/prowl#license). Used 30 GitHub API calls, four failed web-search attempts, and seven page-fetch attempts. Discovery used GitHub repository searches, including a six-month creation filter; this budget-bounded search does not establish global exhaustiveness. No files under the working directory were opened.
